Description: Account registration, sign-in and sign-out with session invalidation.
View public profiles and edit own display name and description.
Search title/author and view book details, including a clear empty result.
Maintain exactly one primary status per user/book; add, move and remove entries; record/clear completion date; support custom shelves.
Accept whole pages 0 to known positive total; calculate page/total x 100; disable unknown totals and prompt for completion at 100%.
Publish, browse, edit and delete own ratings/reviews; show review on book and profile.
Book-specific threads/replies with contributor display name and posting time.
Contributors flag spoiler content; hide text until deliberate reveal. Page/percentage threshold extension remains in US8 backlog.
Read supported EPUBs; owner-only passage notes with create/revisit/delete; safe errors for unreadable files.
Private date-filtered summaries of completed books, grouped by genre and author.
Quarter-star overall rating; optional prose/characters/plot sub-ratings and content warnings; preserve old reviews.
Book-specific buddy groups with invitations, accept/reject and accepted-member-only discussion.
Recommend by community review count descending; title ascending breaks ties; link book details.
Allow author applications for specific books; admin approves verification and labelled author participation.
Follow/unfollow readers; suggestions and feed expose only community-visible activity.
Report content; admin-only queue and dismissal/removal/warning decisions with audit information.
With 100 sample books and one active user, at least 19/20 searches and 19/20 shelf updates finish within 2 seconds from submission to displayed result.
Add from details in at most three actions; at least 4/5 first-time readers complete search, add and status change within 3 minutes with only a task prompt.
Core controls have visible labels or accessible names, keyboard operation and visible focus; core workflow is mouse-free; status/errors do not rely on colour alone.
Authenticated operations reject changes to another user profile, shelf, review or note; dedicated password hashing; sign-out invalidates session.
Saved personal records survive reopening; failed save shows error, retains last saved data and never claims success. In-memory adapter is test-only.
Separate presentation, application rules and storage. Adapter replacement requires no changes to search or shelf screens; verify same checks and dependencies.
Future persistent service: 10,000 books, 50 concurrent users, five-minute trial; at least 95% of searches/updates within 3 seconds and error rate below 1%; record hardware/workload.
Shelves, progress, EPUBs, notes and summaries are owner-private; profiles/reviews/public forum community-visible; groups accepted-member-only; verify second-account retrieval.
